attributes: Opportunity Stage, Opportunity Type, Opportunity Creator Profile, Opportunity Source Detailed, Opportunity Creator Team
goal: Track sales opportunity pipeline performance across different deal stages (M1, S0, S1) to monitor weekly and multi-week revenue generation and team productivity.
user_context: Sales directors and revenue operations teams use this dashboard during weekly and monthly business reviews to track pipeline generation performance across different opportunity stages (M1, S0, S1), analyzing both deal count and ACV metrics by individual contributors, teams, and lead sources to identify top performers, assess team productivity, compare current week performance against historical periods, drill down into specific deals created in recent timeframes, understand lead source effectiveness, and monitor opportunity progression through sales stages while excluding closed won deals to focus on active pipeline creation and early-stage funnel health.
